rawVariants.rawRef: 6. Interim NETRJS Specifications, R. T. Braden, NWG/RFC #189, NIC #7133.
Braden, R. "Interim NETRJS Specification," RFC 189 , NIC 7133, 15-July-71.

1. "Interim NETRJS Specifications", R. T. Braden. RFC #189: NIC #7133, July 15, 1971. This was the basic system programmer's definition document. The proposed changes mentioned on the first page of RFC #189 were never implemented, since the DTP then in vogue became obsolete.
